title: Will The Girl Of Your Dreams by Ashe have above 20000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026 tracking week? Above 20K
rules: If The Girl Of Your Dreams by Ashe has above 20K Album Equivalent Units during the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 16, 2026 - October 22, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Ashe's lead single 'Stop the Wedding!' just reached No. 34 on the Hot 100 and was still climbing when the album dropped Oct 16 on Atlantic, with 245K+ Spotify pre-saves and many physical variants and in-store events. A No. 34-level single plus first-week streams of the other tracks likely gives about 20-25K streaming units, and physical sales should add 8-20K, putting the total around 30-40K. The main risk is that her breakout is concentrated in the UK and Ireland, and her earlier albums barely charted in the U.S.
blind.falsifier: Luminate reports the album's debut week at or below 20,000 units, for example because U.S. album-track streaming is weak and physical sales come in under about 5K.

final.reasoning: The market sits above my 0.80 estimate, likely reflecting midweek sales projections I couldn't access, so I moved up to about 0.86. That is too close to the 0.89 midpoint, and inside the wide spread, to justify a NO bet.
